ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface with high-intensity (white) localized point clusters; high macro-contrast between the fluke body and the high-intensity background water.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black/dark grey) pigmentation covers ~95% of the visible surface. Multiple discrete high-intensity (white) circular blobs ranging from 2-10 pixels in diameter are scattered across both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 125 degrees; the notch apex is well-defined and centered between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary. Profiles show irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 3-8 pixels in depth relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex leading sweep with a sharp upturn at the distal tips; trailing edge trajectory is non-linear due to heavy serration but follows a general concave curve toward the center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of ~15-20 circular high-contrast light-grey pixel clusters across the dark fluke surface, consistent with rosette-patterned scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy high-intensity (white) irregular massing and encrustations visible on both distal tips, indicative of barnacle colonization. Extensive circular scarring patterns across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge topography characterized by deep, uneven serrations.
